message:
The build completed. Now let me compile the fuzzer with ASan:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpsd/fuzzer && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -I../gpsd-3.25.1~dev/include/ -Wall -pthread -std=c99 -c FuzzPacket.c -o FuzzPacket_asan.o && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -c test_main.c -o test_main.o && g++ -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -o FuzzPacket_asan FuzzPacket_asan.o test_main.o -L../gpsd-3.25.1~dev/ -lgpsd -lgps_static -lm -lrt -lnsl 2>&1</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
